title: B.Tech Admission through UPTAC Counselling 2026-27
steps: Candidates allotted AKGEC through UPTAC Counselling 2026 who have frozen their choices must complete physical reporting at the college.
Bring original documents and photocopies in the specified order for verification.
Complete the institute admission form and required forms including MIS form, student ID card application, fee undertaking and attendance undertaking.
Submit the online anti-ragging undertakings signed by the student and parent as required.
Complete admission formalities by submitting the required fees and documents according to the UPTAC allotment letter and college instructions.
note: Transport form is required only if applicable. Consult the official reporting instructions for the complete document checklist, fees and updates.
